Tables are {ns.table} tokens, see suite.py TABLES. answer_tlc_single: the answer with the six-month TLC globs replaced by the January file (--tlc-single). duckdb_ms: hot median of 3 fresh-process runs, 8 threads, when recorded; indicative only.

cases.sql: SELECT d.d_year, sum(ss.ss_net_paid) AS revenue, count(*) AS n FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.date_dim} d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year ORDER BY d.d_year

SELECT s.s_state, sum(ss.ss_net_paid) AS revenue FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.date_dim} d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN {ds.store} s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND ss.ss_quantity > 10 GROUP BY s.s_state ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_brand, sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sum_agg FROM {ds.date_dim} d, {ds.store_sales} ss, {ds.item} i WHERE d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND i.i_manufact_id = 128 AND d.d_moy = 11 GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id ORDER BY d.d_year, sum_agg DESC, i.i_brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i.i_category, count(*) AS n, sum(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.date_dim} d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN {ds.store} s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN {ds.item} i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN {ds.household_demographics} hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE hd.hd_dep_count = 4 AND d.d_year = 2000 AND s.s_state = 'TN' GROUP BY i.i_category ORDER BY i.i_category

SELECT i.i_item_id, avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1, avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2, avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4 FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.customer_demographics} cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN {ds.date_dim} d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN {ds.item} i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN {ds.promotion} p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'M' AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College' AND (p.p_channel_email = 'N' OR p.p_channel_event = 'N') AND d.d_year = 2000 GROUP BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY i.i_item_id LIMIT 100

SELECT p.p_channel_tv, count(*) AS n, sum(ss.ss_net_paid) AS paid FROM {ds.store_sales} ss LEFT JOIN {ds.promotion} p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_channel_tv ORDER BY p.p_channel_tv NULLS FIRST

SELECT i.i_category, count(*) AS sold, count(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS returned, count(sr.sr_ticket_number) * 1.0 / count(*) AS return_rate FROM {ds.store_sales} ss LEFT JOIN {ds.store_returns} sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk JOIN {ds.item} i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_category ORDER BY return_rate DESC

SELECT count(DISTINCT ss_customer_sk) AS cross_channel_customers FROM {ds.store_sales} WHERE ss_customer_sk IN (SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk FROM {ds.web_sales}) AND ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM {ds.date_dim} WHERE d_year = 2001)
SELECT count(*) AS never_sold_on_web FROM {ds.item} WHERE i_item_sk NOT IN (SELECT ws_item_sk FROM {ds.web_sales} WHERE ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL)

SELECT count(*) AS store_only_customers FROM {ds.customer} c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {ds.store_sales} ss WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {ds.catalog_sales} cs WHERE cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)

SELECT ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, count(*) AS n, avg(ss.ss_net_paid) AS avg_paid FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.household_demographics} hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN {ds.income_band} ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ORDER BY ib.ib_lower_bound

WITH yearly AS ( SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk, sum(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.date_dim} d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2001 GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk) SELECT c.c_birth_country, avg(y.total) AS avg_total, count(*) AS customers FROM yearly y JOIN {ds.customer} c ON y.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_birth_country ORDER BY avg_total DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT s.s_store_name, x.cnt FROM (SELECT ss_store_sk, count(*) AS cnt FROM {ds.store_sales} GROUP BY ss_store_sk) x JOIN {ds.store} s ON x.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk ORDER BY x.cnt DESC, s.s_store_name

SELECT i.i_category, sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.item} i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_current_price > 50.00 GROUP BY i.i_category ORDER BY i.i_category
SELECT count(*) AS sold_above_list FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.item} i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE ss.ss_sales_price > i.i_current_price

SELECT i.i_category, sum(ss.ss_quantity * i.i_current_price) AS at_list, sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS actual FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.item} i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_category ORDER BY i.i_category

SELECT d.d_date, count(*) AS n, sum(ss.ss_net_paid) AS paid FROM {ds.store_sales} ss JOIN {ds.date_dim} d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2000-01-31' GROUP BY d.d_date ORDER BY d.d_date
